name: Feature Deck
description: Four cards in a grid; choosing one grows it into the main card while the others move into a row of tiles beneath it.

props.name: cards
props.type: { id: string; title: string; summary: string; content: ReactNode; src?: string; alt?: string }[]
props.description: The cards, laid out two to a row. Each is a button showing its image, title and summary; once chosen it shows its content, which sits in a dark scope over the image.

props.name: backLabel
props.description: Label of the button on the main card that returns to the grid. Escape does the same.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the deck. Give it a height; the cards share it.
